newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest-July 10.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest-July 10.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and People News.
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

PARIS - France's smallest private general terrestrial television station, M6, is increasing its share of the TV advertising market in line with growth in its audience and improvements in its image, managing director Nicolas de Tavernost said. (Reuter)

PARIS - The share of France's television advertising market held by the biggest French private television station, TF1, dipped to 51.64 percent in 1996 from 52.43 percent in 1995, French broadcasting watchdog CSA says. (Reuter)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET:
PARIS - The French public television channels say they are launching a history channel on the symbolic date of July 14, to be carried on France's cable and satellite TV services. (Reuter)

PARIS - French television channels have been showing less violence in programmes likely to be seen by children, thanks to a voluntary code put in place last year, France's broadcasting watchdog says.(Reuter)

PARIS - France 2, the biggest French public television channel, says it had a net loss of 199.3 million francs ($33.4 million) in 1996 compared with a net profit of 60.7 million francs in 1995. The loss was much bigger than a forecast published in Le Monde newspaper last month of a 70 million franc loss. (Reuter)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:

PARIS - Ricard, the market-leading aniseed drink with the highest awareness level among all alcoholic beverages in France, is changing the design of its bottle for the first time in years. (Ad Age Daily world Wire)
PARIS - Lancome is planning its first simultaneous launch across France, the U.S., Japan and the rest of Europe for the debut of its Primordiale Nuit night cream. (Ad Age Daily World Wire)

BEIJING - French automaker PSA Peugeot Citroen will push its Peugeot brand in China even after its expected withdrawal from a foundering joint venture in the southern city of Guangzhou, a company official says. (Reuter)
PARIS - French carmaker Automobiles Citroen unveils the sporty Xsara car, its contender in the fiercely competitive lower mid-sized segment dominated in Europe by the Volkswagen Golf. (Reuter)

PARIS - Remy-Cointreau says it may be interested in drink brands up for sale as the result of a planned merger of the drinks businesses of Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc and maybe LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton.(Reuter)
